mapper.sql: WHERE ib.is_deleted = 0 AND s.is_deleted = 0 AND s.active_yn = 'Y' AND p.is_deleted = 0 AND (sp.sales_point_id IS NULL OR (sp.is_deleted = 0 AND sp.active_yn = 'Y')) AND (sc.sales_channel_id IS NULL OR (sc.is_deleted = 0 AND sc.active_yn = 'Y')) AND ( ib.warehouse_id IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM warehouse active_w WHERE active_w.warehouse_id = ib.warehouse_id AND active_w.is_deleted = 0 AND active_w.active_yn = 'Y' ) )

if.test: (q != null and q != '') or (channelTypes != null and channelTypes.size() > 0) or (salesPointCodes != null and salesPointCodes.size() > 0) or (regionCodes != null and regionCodes.size() > 0) or (categoryIds != null and categoryIds.size() > 0) or (storageTypes != null and storageTypes.size() > 0) or (warehouseCodes != null and warehouseCodes.size() > 0) or (riskGrades != null and riskGrades.size() > 0) or (assessmentStatuses != null and assessmentStatuses.size() > 0) or (shortageYn != null and shortageYn != '')

mapper.select: SELECT channel_type AS code, CASE channel_type WHEN 'GREETING' THEN '그리팅' WHEN 'ECOMMERCE' THEN '온라인몰' WHEN 'HYUNDAI_DEPT' THEN '현대백화점' WHEN 'HMART' THEN '직영점' ELSE channel_type END AS name FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN sp.sales_point_code = 'GREETING' THEN 'GREETING' WHEN sp.sales_point_code = 'MODU_MATJIP' THEN 'ECOMMERCE' WHEN sp.sales_point_code LIKE 'DEPT_%' THEN 'HYUNDAI_DEPT' WHEN sp.sales_point_code LIKE 'HMART_%' THEN 'HMART' ELSE sc.channel_code END AS channel_type FROM sales_point sp INNER JOIN sales_channel sc ON sc.sales_channel_id = sp.sales_channel_id WHERE sp.is_deleted = 0 AND sp.active_yn = 'Y' AND sc.is_deleted = 0 AND sc.active_yn = 'Y' ) ORDER BY code

SELECT sp.sales_point_code AS code, sp.sales_point_name AS name, sp.region_code AS region_code, CASE WHEN sp.sales_point_code = 'GREETING' THEN 'GREETING' WHEN sp.sales_point_code = 'MODU_MATJIP' THEN 'ECOMMERCE' WHEN sp.sales_point_code LIKE 'DEPT_%' THEN 'HYUNDAI_DEPT' WHEN sp.sales_point_code LIKE 'HMART_%' THEN 'HMART' ELSE sc.channel_code END AS channel_type FROM sales_point sp INNER JOIN sales_channel sc ON sc.sales_channel_id = sp.sales_channel_id WHERE sp.is_deleted = 0 AND sp.active_yn = 'Y' AND sc.is_deleted = 0 AND sc.active_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY sp.sales_point_code

SELECT w.warehouse_code AS code, w.warehouse_name AS name, w.region_code AS region_code, CASE WHEN COUNT(ib.inventory_balance_id) > 0 THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE 'REGISTERED_EMPTY' END AS availability, COUNT(DISTINCT ib.sku_id) AS current_sku_count, COUNT(ib.inventory_balance_id) AS current_balance_row_count, NVL(SUM(ib.on_hand_qty), 0) AS current_on_hand_qty FROM warehouse w LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ib.warehouse_id, ib.sku_id, ib.inventory_balance_id, ib.on_hand_qty FROM inventory_balance ib INNER JOIN sku active_s ON active_s.sku_id = ib.sku_id AND active_s.is_deleted = 0 AND active_s.active_yn = 'Y' WHERE ib.is_deleted = 0 ) ib ON ib.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id WHERE w.is_deleted = 0 AND w.active_yn = 'Y' GROUP BY w.warehouse_code, w.warehouse_name, w.region_code ORDER BY w.warehouse_code

SELECT DISTINCT sp.region_code AS code, CASE WHEN sp.region_code = 'SEOUL' THEN '서울권' WHEN sp.region_code = 'GYEONGGI' THEN '경기권' WHEN sp.region_code = 'BUSAN' THEN '부산/경남권' WHEN sp.region_code = 'DAEGU' THEN '대구/경북권' WHEN sp.region_code = 'CHUNGCHEONG' THEN '충청/대전권' WHEN sp.region_code = 'ULSAN' THEN '울산권' WHEN sp.region_code = 'ONLINE' THEN '온라인/전국' ELSE sp.region_code END AS name FROM sales_point sp WHERE sp.is_deleted = 0 AND sp.active_yn = 'Y' AND sp.region_code IS NOT NULL ORDER BY code

SELECT TO_CHAR(c.category_id) AS code, c.category_name AS name, TO_CHAR(c.parent_category_id) AS parent_code, c.category_level AS category_level FROM category c WHERE c.is_deleted = 0 AND c.active_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY c.category_level, c.category_id

SELECT normalized_storage_type AS code, CASE normalized_storage_type WHEN 'FROZEN' THEN '냉동' WHEN 'COLD' THEN '냉장' WHEN 'ROOM_TEMP' THEN '상온' ELSE normalized_storage_type END AS name FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT CASE s.storage_type WHEN 'AMBIENT' THEN 'ROOM_TEMP' ELSE s.storage_type END AS normalized_storage_type FROM sku s WHERE s.is_deleted = 0 AND s.active_yn = 'Y' AND s.storage_type IS NOT NULL ) ORDER BY code

WITH balance_base AS ( SELECT ib.sku_id, NVL(ib.stock_sales_point_id, NVL(ib.allocated_sales_point_id, -1)) AS sales_point_id, CASE WHEN ib.stock_sales_point_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'OWNED' WHEN ib.allocated_sales_point_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'ALLOCATED_ONLY' ELSE 'CENTER_ONLY' END AS sales_point_state, ib.allocated_sales_point_id, ib.warehouse_id, ib.lot_id, ib.on_hand_qty, ib.reserved_qty, ib.updated_at, l.lot_status, l.expiry_date, l.sale_stop_date FROM inventory_balance ib INNER JOIN sku s ON s.sku_id = ib.sku_id LEFT JOIN sales_point sp ON sp.sales_point_id = NVL(ib.stock_sales_point_id, ib.allocated_sales_point_id) LEFT JOIN warehouse active_w ON active_w.warehouse_id = ib.warehouse_id AND active_w.is_deleted = 0 AND active_w.active_yn = 'Y' LEFT JOIN lot l ON l.lot_id = ib.lot_id AND l.is_deleted = 0 WHERE ib.is_deleted = 0 AND s.is_deleted = 0 AND s.active_yn = 'Y' AND (sp.sales_point_id IS NULL OR (sp.is_deleted = 0 AND sp.active_yn = 'Y')) AND s.sku_code = #{skuCode} AND ( (#{salesPointCode} != 'UNASSIGNED' AND sp.sales_point_code = #{salesPointCode}) OR (#{salesPointCode} = 'UNASSIGNED' AND ib.allocated_sales_point_id IS NULL) ) ), detail_disposal_forecast_ranked AS ( SELECT df.forecast_id, df.sku_id, df.sales_point_id, df.predicted_qty_d7, df.predicted_qty_d14, df.predicted_qty_d30, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY df.sku_id, df.sales_point_id ORDER BY df.base_date DESC, df.updated_at DESC, df.forecast_id DESC ) AS rn FROM demand_forecast df INNER JOIN ml_model_version mv ON mv.model_version_id = df.model_version_id AND mv.status = 'ACTIVE' AND mv.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT sku_id FROM balance_base) detail_sku ON detail_sku.sku_id = df.sku_id WHERE df.is_deleted = 0 AND df.base_date <= TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate} AS DATE)) AND df.forecast_source <> 'DUMMY_BASELINE' ), detail_latest_disposal_forecast AS ( SELECT forecast_id, sku_id, sales_point_id, predicted_qty_d7, predicted_qty_d14, predicted_qty_d30 FROM detail_disposal_forecast_ranked WHERE rn = 1 ), detail_disposal_lot_dates AS ( SELECT bb.sku_id, bb.allocated_sales_point_id, bb.on_hand_qty, bb.lot_status, CASE WHEN bb.expiry_date IS NOT NULL AND bb.sale_stop_date IS NOT NULL THEN LEAST(TRUNC(bb.expiry_date), TRUNC(bb.sale_stop_date)) WHEN bb.expiry_date IS NOT NULL THEN TRUNC(bb.expiry_date) WHEN bb.sale_stop_date IS NOT NULL THEN TRUNC(bb.sale_stop_date) END AS sale_end_date FROM balance_base bb ), detail_disposal_scope AS ( SELECT sku_id, allocated_sales_point_id, SUM(CASE WHEN sale_end_date <= TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate} AS DATE)) + 7 THEN on_hand_qty ELSE 0 END) AS expiring_qty_d7, SUM(CASE WHEN sale_end_date <= TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate} AS DATE)) + 14 THEN on_hand_qty ELSE 0 END) AS expiring_qty_d14, SUM(on_hand_qty) AS expiring_qty_d30 FROM detail_disposal_lot_dates WHERE on_hand_qty > 0 AND (lot_status IS NULL OR lot_status NOT IN ('EXPIRED', 'SALE_STOPPED', 'DEPLETED')) AND sale_end_date > TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate} AS DATE)) AND sale_end_date <= TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate} AS DATE)) + 30 GROUP BY sku_id, allocated_sales_point_id ), detail_disposal AS ( SELECT ds.sku_id, SUM(CASE WHEN ds.allocated_sales_point_id IS NULL OR lf.forecast_id IS NULL OR lf.predicted_qty_d7 IS NULL OR lf.predicted_qty_d14 IS NULL OR lf.predicted_qty_d30 IS NULL OR lf.predicted_qty_d7 < 0 OR lf.predicted_qty_d14 < 0 OR lf.predicted_qty_d30 < 0 OR lf.predicted_qty_d7 > lf.predicted_qty_d14 OR lf.predicted_qty_d14 > lf.predicted_qty_d30 THEN ds.expiring_qty_d30 ELSE GREATEST( 0, ds.expiring_qty_d7 - lf.predicted_qty_d7, ds.expiring_qty_d14 - lf.predicted_qty_d14, ds.expiring_qty_d30 - lf.predicted_qty_d30 ) END) AS expected_disposal_qty FROM detail_disposal_scope ds LEFT JOIN detail_latest_disposal_forecast lf ON lf.sku_id = ds.sku_id AND lf.sales_point_id = ds.allocated_sales_point_id GROUP BY ds.sku_id ), unassigned_balance_base AS ( SELECT ib.sku_id, ib.warehouse_id, ib.lot_id, ib.on_hand_qty, ib.reserved_qty, ib.updated_at, l.lot_status, l.expiry_date, l.sale_stop_date FROM inventory_balance ib INNER JOIN sku s ON s.sku_id = ib.sku_id LEFT JOIN lot l ON l.lot_id = ib.lot_id AND l.is_deleted = 0 WHERE ib.is_deleted = 0 AND s.is_deleted = 0 AND s.active_yn = 'Y' AND s.sku_code = #{skuCode} AND ib.allocated_sales_point_id IS NULL ), unassigned_agg AS ( SELECT sku_id, SUM(on_hand_qty + reserved_qty) AS current_qty, SUM(CASE WHEN lot_status IN ('EXPIRED', 'SALE_STOPPED', 'DEPLETED') OR (expiry_date IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(expiry_date) <= TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate} AS DATE))) OR (sale_stop_date IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(sale_stop_date) <= TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate} AS DATE))) THEN 0 ELSE on_hand_qty END) AS available_qty, SUM(CASE WHEN lot_status IN ('EXPIRED', 'SALE_STOPPED', 'DEPLETED') OR (expiry_date IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(expiry_date) <= TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate} AS DATE))) OR (sale_stop_date IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(sale_stop_date) <= TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate} AS DATE))) THEN 0 ELSE reserved_qty END) AS reserved_qty, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN lot_status = 'EXPIRED' OR (expiry_date IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(expiry_date) <= TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate} AS DATE))) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'EXPIRED_INCLUDED' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN lot_status = 'SALE_STOPPED' OR (sale_stop_date IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(sale_stop_date) <= TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate} AS DATE))) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'SALE_STOPPED_INCLUDED' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN lot_status = 'DEPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = COUNT(*) THEN 'DEPLETED_ONLY' WHEN SUM(on_hand_qty) = 0 THEN 'OUT_OF_STOCK' ELSE 'AVAILABLE' END AS inventory_fact_state FROM unassigned_balance_base GROUP BY sku_id ), row_agg AS ( SELECT sku_id, sales_point_id, SUM(on_hand_qty + reserved_qty) AS current_qty, SUM(CASE WHEN lot_status IN ('EXPIRED', 'SALE_STOPPED', 'DEPLETED') OR (expiry_date IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(expiry_date) <= TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate} AS DATE))) OR (sale_stop_date IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(sale_stop_date) <= TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate} AS DATE))) THEN 0 ELSE reserved_qty END) AS reserved_qty, SUM(CASE WHEN lot_status IN ('EXPIRED', 'SALE_STOPPED', 'DEPLETED') OR (expiry_date IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(expiry_date) <= TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate} AS DATE))) OR (sale_stop_date IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(sale_stop_date) <= TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate} AS DATE))) THEN 0 ELSE on_hand_qty END) AS available_qty, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN sales_point_state = 'OWNED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'OWNED' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN sales_point_state = 'ALLOCATED_ONLY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'ALLOCATED_ONLY' ELSE 'CENTER_ONLY' END AS sales_point_state, COUNT(DISTINCT lot_id) AS lot_count, TRUNC(MIN(CASE WHEN expiry_date IS NOT NULL THEN TRUNC(expiry_date) - TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate} AS DATE)) END)) AS nearest_expiry_days, MIN(expiry_date) AS nearest_expiry_date, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN lot_status = 'EXPIRED' OR (expiry_date IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(expiry_date) <= TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate} AS DATE))) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'EXPIRED_INCLUDED' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN lot_status = 'SALE_STOPPED' OR (sale_stop_date IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(sale_stop_date) <= TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate} AS DATE))) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'SALE_STOPPED_INCLUDED' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN lot_status = 'DEPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = COUNT(*) THEN 'DEPLETED_ONLY' WHEN SUM(on_hand_qty) = 0 THEN 'OUT_OF_STOCK' ELSE 'AVAILABLE' END AS inventory_fact_state, MAX(updated_at) AS updated_at FROM balance_base GROUP BY sku_id, sales_point_id ), unassigned_warehouse_rows AS ( SELECT ub.sku_id, COALESCE(w.warehouse_code, 'UNKNOWN') AS warehouse_code, COALESCE(w.warehouse_name, '보관센터 미지정') AS warehouse_name, SUM(ub.on_hand_qty + ub.reserved_qty) AS quantity FROM unassigned_balance_base ub LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON w.warehouse_id = ub.warehouse_id AND w.is_deleted = 0 AND w.active_yn = 'Y' GROUP BY ub.sku_id, COALESCE(w.warehouse_code, 'UNKNOWN'), COALESCE(w.warehouse_name, '보관센터 미지정') ), unassigned_warehouse_agg AS ( SELECT sku_id, COUNT(*) AS location_count, JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT( 'warehouseCode' VALUE warehouse_code, 'warehouseName' VALUE warehouse_name, 'quantity' VALUE quantity RETURNING CLOB ) ORDER BY warehouse_code RETURNING CLOB) AS locations_json FROM unassigned_warehouse_rows GROUP BY sku_id ), latest_price AS ( SELECT sku_id, sales_point_id, selling_price, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY sku_id, sales_point_id ORDER BY effective_from DESC, sku_channel_price_id DESC ) AS rn FROM sku_channel_price WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND effective_from <= #{asOfDate} AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to >= #{asOfDate}) ), latest_policy AS ( SELECT sku_id, COALESCE(stock_sales_point_id, allocated_sales_point_id, -1) AS sales_point_id, safety_stock_qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY sku_id, COALESCE(stock_sales_point_id, allocated_sales_point_id, -1) ORDER BY effective_from DESC NULLS LAST, inventory_policy_id DESC ) AS rn FROM inventory_policy WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND (effective_from IS NULL OR effective_from <= #{asOfDate}) AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to >= #{asOfDate}) ), policy_agg AS ( SELECT sku_id, sales_point_id, safety_stock_qty AS safety_qty FROM latest_policy WHERE rn = 1 ), risk_rows AS ( SELECT ib.sku_id, NVL(ib.stock_sales_point_id, NVL(ib.allocated_sales_point_id, -1)) AS sales_point_id, ra.risk_grade, ra.shortage_yn, ra.reason_message, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY ib.sku_id, NVL(ib.stock_sales_point_id, NVL(ib.allocated_sales_point_id, -1)) ORDER BY ra.updated_at DESC, ra.risk_assessment_id DESC ) AS rn FROM risk_assessment ra INNER JOIN inventory_balance ib ON ib.inventory_balance_id = ra.inventory_balance_id AND ib.is_deleted = 0 WHERE ra.is_deleted = 0 ), risk_agg AS ( SELECT sku_id, sales_point_id, CASE risk_grade WHEN 'GOOD' THEN 'SAFE' WHEN 'WARNING' THEN 'CAUTION' WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 'DANGER' ELSE risk_grade END AS risk_grade, CASE WHEN risk_grade IS NULL THEN 'UNASSESSED' ELSE 'ASSESSED' END AS assessment_status, shortage_yn, reason_message AS risk_reason FROM risk_rows WHERE rn = 1 ) SELECT ra.sku_id, p.product_code, p.product_name, sup.supplier_name AS supplier_name, p.image_url, s.sku_code, s.sku_name, c.category_id, c.category_name, c.category_level, cp.category_id AS parent_category_id, cp.category_name AS parent_category_name, cp.category_level AS parent_category_level, cg.category_id AS grandparent_category_id, cg.category_name AS grandparent_category_name, cg.category_level AS grandparent_category_level, CASE WHEN sp.sales_point_code = 'GREETING' THEN 'GREETING' WHEN sp.sales_point_code = 'MODU_MATJIP' THEN 'ECOMMERCE' WHEN sp.sales_point_code LIKE 'DEPT_%' THEN 'HYUNDAI_DEPT' WHEN sp.sales_point_code LIKE 'HMART_%' THEN 'HMART' WHEN sp.sales_point_code IS NULL THEN 'CENTER' ELSE sc.channel_code END AS channel_type, NVL(sp.sales_point_code, 'UNASSIGNED') AS sales_point_code, NVL(sp.sales_point_name, '판매처 미할당') AS sales_point_name, CASE WHEN s.storage_type = 'AMBIENT' THEN 'ROOM_TEMP' ELSE s.storage_type END AS storage_type, price.selling_price, ra.current_qty AS current_qty, ra.available_qty AS available_qty, ra.reserved_qty AS reserved_qty, policy.safety_qty AS safety_qty, ra.inventory_fact_state, risk.risk_grade, risk.assessment_status, risk.shortage_yn, risk.risk_reason, uaw.locations_json, uaw.locations_json AS unassigned_locations_json, uaw.location_count, uaw.location_count AS unassigned_location_count, JSON_ARRAY(JSON_OBJECT( 'salesPointId' VALUE NULLIF(ra.sales_point_id, -1), 'salesPointCode' VALUE NVL(sp.sales_point_code, 'UNASSIGNED'), 'salesPointName' VALUE NVL(sp.sales_point_name, '판매처 미할당'), 'channelType' VALUE CASE WHEN sp.sales_point_code = 'GREETING' THEN 'GREETING' WHEN sp.sales_point_code = 'MODU_MATJIP' THEN 'ECOMMERCE' WHEN sp.sales_point_code LIKE 'DEPT_%' THEN 'HYUNDAI_DEPT' WHEN sp.sales_point_code LIKE 'HMART_%' THEN 'HMART' WHEN sp.sales_point_code IS NULL THEN 'CENTER' ELSE sc.channel_code END, 'currentQuantity' VALUE ra.current_qty, 'availableQuantity' VALUE ra.available_qty, 'reservedQuantity' VALUE ra.reserved_qty, 'riskGrade' VALUE risk.risk_grade, 'shortageYn' VALUE risk.shortage_yn, 'salesPointState' VALUE ra.sales_point_state, 'warehouseName' VALUE CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(200)), 'sellingPrice' VALUE price.selling_price RETURNING CLOB) RETURNING CLOB) AS sales_points_json, ua.current_qty AS unassigned_current_qty, ua.available_qty AS unassigned_available_qty, ua.reserved_qty AS unassigned_reserved_qty, ua.inventory_fact_state AS unassigned_inventory_fact_state, (SELECT r.shortage_yn FROM risk_agg r WHERE r.sku_id = ra.sku_id AND r.sales_point_id = -1) AS unassigned_shortage_yn, (SELECT r.risk_grade FROM risk_agg r WHERE r.sku_id = ra.sku_id AND r.sales_point_id = -1) AS unassigned_risk_grade, (SELECT r.assessment_status FROM risk_agg r WHERE r.sku_id = ra.sku_id AND r.sales_point_id = -1) AS unassigned_assessment_status, (SELECT r.risk_reason FROM risk_agg r WHERE r.sku_id = ra.sku_id AND r.sales_point_id = -1) AS unassigned_risk_reason, ra.lot_count, ra.nearest_expiry_days, ra.nearest_expiry_date, ra.updated_at, NVL(disposal.expected_disposal_qty, 0) AS expected_disposal_qty FROM row_agg ra INNER JOIN sku s ON s.sku_id = ra.sku_id INNER JOIN product p ON p.product_id = s.product_id LEFT JOIN supplier sup ON sup.supplier_id = p.supplier_id AND sup.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN category c ON c.category_id = p.category_id LEFT JOIN category cp ON cp.category_id = c.parent_category_id AND cp.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN category cg ON cg.category_id = cp.parent_category_id AND cg.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sales_point sp ON sp.sales_point_id = ra.sales_point_id LEFT JOIN sales_channel sc ON sc.sales_channel_id = sp.sales_channel_id LEFT JOIN unassigned_agg ua ON ua.sku_id = ra.sku_id LEFT JOIN unassigned_warehouse_agg uaw ON uaw.sku_id = ra.sku_id LEFT JOIN latest_price price ON price.sku_id = ra.sku_id AND price.sales_point_id = ra.sales_point_id AND price.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN policy_agg policy ON policy.sku_id = ra.sku_id AND policy.sales_point_id = ra.sales_point_id LEFT JOIN risk_agg risk ON risk.sku_id = ra.sku_id AND risk.sales_point_id = ra.sales_point_id LEFT JOIN detail_disposal disposal ON disposal.sku_id = ra.sku_id

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT 1 FROM inventory_balance ib INNER JOIN sku s ON s.sku_id = ib.sku_id AND s.is_deleted = 0 AND s.active_yn = 'Y' LEFT JOIN sales_point sp ON sp.sales_point_id = NVL(ib.stock_sales_point_id, ib.allocated_sales_point_id) WHERE ib.is_deleted = 0 AND s.sku_code = #{skuCode} AND (sp.sales_point_id IS NULL OR (sp.is_deleted = 0 AND sp.active_yn = 'Y')) AND ( (#{salesPointCode} != 'UNASSIGNED' AND sp.sales_point_code = #{salesPointCode}) OR (#{salesPointCode} = 'UNASSIGNED' AND ib.allocated_sales_point_id IS NULL) ) AND ROWNUM = 1 )

WITH lot_agg AS ( SELECT l.lot_id, l.lot_no, l.lot_status, l.manufactured_date, l.received_date, l.expiry_date, l.sale_stop_date, SUM(ib.on_hand_qty + ib.reserved_qty) AS quantity, SUM(CASE WHEN l.lot_status IN ('EXPIRED', 'SALE_STOPPED', 'DEPLETED') OR (l.expiry_date IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(l.expiry_date) <= TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate} AS DATE))) OR (l.sale_stop_date IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(l.sale_stop_date) <= TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate} AS DATE))) THEN 0 ELSE ib.reserved_qty END) AS reserved_quantity, SUM(CASE WHEN l.lot_status IN ('EXPIRED', 'SALE_STOPPED', 'DEPLETED') OR (l.expiry_date IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(l.expiry_date) <= TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate} AS DATE))) OR (l.sale_stop_date IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(l.sale_stop_date) <= TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate} AS DATE))) THEN 0 ELSE ib.on_hand_qty END) AS available_quantity, TRUNC(CASE WHEN l.expiry_date IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TRUNC(l.expiry_date) - TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate} AS DATE)) END) AS expiry_days, CASE WHEN #{salesPointCode} = 'UNASSIGNED' THEN COALESCE(MIN(w.warehouse_code) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY w.warehouse_code), 'UNKNOWN') END AS warehouse_code, CASE WHEN #{salesPointCode} = 'UNASSIGNED' THEN COALESCE(MIN(w.warehouse_name) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY w.warehouse_code), '보관센터 미지정') END AS warehouse_name FROM inventory_balance ib INNER JOIN lot l ON l.lot_id = ib.lot_id AND l.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN sku s ON s.sku_id = ib.sku_id AND s.is_deleted = 0 AND s.active_yn = 'Y' LEFT JOIN sales_point sp ON sp.sales_point_id = NVL(ib.stock_sales_point_id, ib.allocated_sales_point_id) LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON w.warehouse_id = ib.warehouse_id AND w.is_deleted = 0 AND w.active_yn = 'Y' WHERE ib.is_deleted = 0 AND s.sku_code = #{skuCode} AND ( (#{salesPointCode} != 'UNASSIGNED' AND sp.sales_point_code = #{salesPointCode}) OR (#{salesPointCode} = 'UNASSIGNED' AND ib.allocated_sales_point_id IS NULL) ) GROUP BY l.lot_id, l.lot_no, l.lot_status, l.manufactured_date, l.received_date, l.expiry_date, l.sale_stop_date ) SELECT lot_id, lot_no AS lot_number, lot_status, quantity, available_quantity, reserved_quantity, manufactured_date, received_date, expiry_date, sale_stop_date, expiry_days, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY CASE WHEN expiry_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, expiry_date NULLS LAST, received_date NULLS LAST, lot_no ) AS fefo_priority, warehouse_code, warehouse_name FROM lot_agg ORDER BY fefo_priority

SELECT scp.sku_channel_price_id, scp.sku_id, s.sku_code, scp.sales_point_id, sp.sales_point_code, sp.sales_point_name, scp.selling_price, scp.actual_price, scp.minimum_selling_price, scp.effective_from, scp.effective_to, CASE WHEN scp.selling_price IS NULL THEN 'NOT_LOADED' WHEN scp.effective_to IS NOT NULL AND scp.effective_to < #{asOfDate} THEN 'STALE' ELSE 'AVAILABLE' END AS price_status, scp.updated_at FROM ( SELECT p.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY p.sku_id, p.sales_point_id ORDER BY p.effective_from DESC, p.sku_channel_price_id DESC ) AS rn FROM sku_channel_price p WHERE p.is_deleted = 0 AND p.effective_from <= #{asOfDate} ) scp INNER JOIN sku s ON s.sku_id = scp.sku_id AND s.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN sales_point sp ON sp.sales_point_id = scp.sales_point_id AND sp.is_deleted = 0 WHERE s.sku_code = #{skuCode} AND scp.rn = 1 ORDER BY sp.sales_point_code ASC
